result.reason: The clause appropriately extends use to Affiliates and contractors and removes at-will revocation, but it does not provide that paid-up licences are perpetual and irrevocable. Instead, every licence continues only for the applicable subscription or order term. The required uncured-material-breach termination standard and transferability to an M&A successor are also left dependent on an unseen Section 13.3 rather than stated here. Adding a prohibition on suspension and the undefined “business purposes” formulation goes beyond what is necessary. The drafting is generally clear, but the term language materially misses the playbook position.
